data.name: Sadil
data.gender_notes: Sadil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘sdl’ which means to ride or travel. The name Sadil can be interpreted as someone who is a traveler at heart or someone who rides or moves around a lot. The name Sadil carries the meaning “Rider, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Sadil usually hope their child will grow to embody rider, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages spiritual growth through exploration and travel.
data.etymology: Sadil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rider, Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadil total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: سديد
in_arabic.meaning: سديد يعني الصدق و الإخلاص في القول و الفعل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سديد مشتق من الجذر السدادي و يعني الصدق و الإخلاص في القول و الفعل. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَكَاةَ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْكُتُبِ وَالرُسُلِ وَيَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَلَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُم وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا' (البقرة: 136). وله أهمية كبيرة في التعبير عن الصدق و الإخلاص.

in_urdu.name: سدید
in_urdu.meaning: سدید کا مطلب ہے سچ و خلوص در گفتار و کردار
in_urdu.long_meaning: سدید نام عربی زبان کے سدادی جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے سچ و خلوص در گفتار و کردار. یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے اور قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر کئی جگہوں پر آیا ہے. سدید نام کے معنی شخص کی شخصیت میں صداقت و امانت کی عکاسی کرتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: सदिद
in_hindi.meaning: सदिद का अर्थ है सच और ईमानदारी वचन और कर्म में
in_hindi.long_meaning: सदिद नाम अरबी भाषा के सदादी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है सच और ईमानदारी वचन और कर्म में. इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर आया है और यह इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है. सदिद नाम व्यक्ति के चरित्र में सच्चाई और ईमानदारी की विशेषता को दर्शाता है.

in_pashto.name: سديد
in_pashto.meaning: سديد د صدق او اخلاص په وينا او کړنو کې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: سديد نوم د عربي ژبې د سدادې ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی او معنی يې د صدق او اخلاص په وينا او کړنو کې دي. دا نوم د اسلامي تقويم په تاريخ کې مهم ځای لري او د قرآن کريم په ډيرو ځايونو کې يې ذکر شوی دی. سديد نوم د شخص د شخصيت په صداقت او امانتدارۍ کې انعکاس کوي.

in_english.name: Sadil
in_english.meaning: Sadil means truthfulness and sincerity in speech and action
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sadil is derived from the Arabic root 's-d-d', which conveys the meaning of truthfulness and sincerity in speech and action. It is mentioned in several places in the Quran, including Surah Al-Baqarah (2:136). The name Sadil holds significant importance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the values of honesty and integrity. It is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person's commitment to being truthful and sincere.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sadil carries a sense of adventure and a love for exploration. It signifies someone who is not content with staying in one place and is always seeking new experiences. This name can be particularly fitting for individuals who enjoy traveling or those who work in fields that require constant movement, such as transportation or logistics.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the idea of traveling or journeying is often used as a metaphor for the spiritual journey toward God. The Prophet Muhammad once said, "The traveler is not accountable for his speech or actions until he reaches his destination" (Bukhari). Sadil, as a name, can be seen as a reminder to constantly be on a spiritual journey, to keep moving forward towards growth and self-improvement. Additionally, the name may evoke images of the prophet Solomon (Sulayman) who was renowned for his journeys and wise judgments.
